basic_info.description: Heart of Nob Hill..$665 per sq ft...Unit has the possibility to buy exclusive rights to Pano View roof w/ the possibility of bldg your dream deck. Price w/ exclusive use of the roof w/ this unit is $1,350,000. You will fall in love w/ this gem.TOP floor home-like full flat w/ that old school SF vibe w/ all new amenities. Incredible light-filled unit Approx 1800 sq ft. Full Span Golden Gate Bridge views from living room and Primary bedroom. 3 bedrooms. One remodeled full bath plus separate 1/4 bath. The primary bedroom has the ability and is set up to build a master bath. Remodeled eat-in kitchen w lovely tree views.Formal gorgeous dining room w original China cabinets w lead glass. Beautiful hardwood throughout. laundry room off of kitchen  w washer / dryer..Walk to the organic, gourmet Le Beau market. Huntington Park. Children's playground included in park too. Grace Cathedral minutes away. A 10 min walk to Polk St shopping w/ the new Bi-Rite market. North Beach is a 10 min walk heading East..HOA dues approx $593 per month. Don't miss this amazing home-like Top floor unit w all the bells and whistles.Park your car directly across the street and come home to this GEM.
